summary: Added eight meaningful Bun RED tests for AFC-05 across three lane-owned files. They reproduce required coverage incorrectly folding to warn/pass, absent incomplete coverage when FAIL dominates, source filters dropping required checks, malformed rc0 audit output reporting clean, Bun package-keyed advisories being lost, and service/CLI exit zero for incomplete. Synthetic Bun/npm fixtures are public and local; runtime cases invoke runHealth through a temporary fake node_modules/.bin/bun and perform no network or real audit. The focused result is 0 pass / 8 fail while root typecheck remains green. No production, dependency, git, flow-state, or acceptance-criteria file was changed.

AFC05-fail-dominates-incomplete requires P0 to remain FAIL with coverage=incomplete. AFC05-audit-rc0-unparsed and AFC05-audit-rc1-findings exercise parse validity and finding retention through the real runHealth adapter path.

acceptance.criterion: Synthetic Bun package-keyed arrays and npm modern/legacy formats parse; unknown/malformed output cannot report clean even rc0.
acceptance.evidence: AFC05-audit-public-formats uses only invented package/advisory values and requires deterministic unique identities plus P0/P1 severity mapping for Bun, npm modern, and npm legacy formats. The separate rc0 malformed fixture proves invalid output cannot become a clean available source.

acceptance.criterion: Strict health CLI/service reject incomplete; optional skips visible and source-filter coverage truthful.
acceptance.evidence: AFC05-service-blocks-incomplete and AFC05-cli-blocks-incomplete require exit code one. AFC05-source-filter-coverage requires omitted policy-required eslint/typescript checks to remain in the report and make the gate incomplete; the gate-fold case keeps optional skip visible without degrading required coverage.
